item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Disentangling psychological interventions for mental disorders into a taxonomy of active ingredients (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

Psychological interventions for severe mental disorders are generally effective treatment options combined with other interventions, but crucial aspects related to mechanisms and personalization are still unexplored. The complexity of cases such as psychotic, bipolar, substance use, eating and borderline personality requires knowledge of mechanisms of change and a more individualised approach, beyond theapplication of one-size-fit-all treatment packages. item.description:

Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-03 Psicologia sociale, del lavoro e delle organizzazioni

The project-based position within the activities of the Chair of Social Psychology at the Department of For.Psi.Com. will focus on the study and research of behaviours and attitudes related to health information and the informed use of medicines and vaccinations across different population subgroups. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: IdR75/26 - Digital Technologies and Artificial Intelligence for Occupational Well-Being: Innovative Assessment, Human–Technology Interaction, and Psychosocial Risk Prevention (Univ. VERONA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 13:00
Institution: Univ. VERONA, Verona
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-03 Psicologia sociale, del lavoro e delle organizzazioni

The research programme investigates the role of digital technologies and artificial intelligence in promoting occupational well-being and preventing psychosocial risks. Particular attention will be devoted to the development and evaluation of innovative assessment approaches, including digital measures and vocal biomarkers, and to the study of human–technology interaction in work settings. The research will examine acceptance, trust, usability, and the psychological and organisational effects of intelligent systems, integrating qualitative and quantitative methods, longitudinal designs, and advanced data analysis. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Diversity-Inclusive Communication by future care and social work professionals (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-24 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

COM-IN aims to strengthen inclusive communication skills among health and social care students and professionals to promote person-centred care for people with disabilities. The project will identify educational needs, review good practices, develop accessible digital learning resources, and pilot and validate them across four European countries.

Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

The project investigates the clinical-psychological aspects of chronic pain, with a focus on nociplastic pain conditions (fibromyalgia) and their psychopathological comorbidities. The research assistant will support the research group in designing and conducting clinical-psychological assessment protocols in patients with chronic pain, in data analysis, and in the scientific dissemination of results
